description: This file defines the ModuleNode class in the Twig templating engine, responsible for representing and compiling template modules, including methods for class generation, template compilation, and handling parent/child relationships.

classes.name: ModuleNode
classes.description: Final class extending Node, representing a Twig template module with methods for compilation and source code generation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ModuleNode with template components, setting source context.

methods.name: setIndex
methods.description: Sets the index attribute for the node.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Main method to compile the template node into PHP code.

methods.name: compileTemplate
methods.description: Handles the detailed compilation of the template class structure.

methods.name: compileGetParent
methods.description: Generates code for the doGetParent method if a parent node exists.

methods.name: compileClassHeader
methods.description: Generates the class header, including use statements and class declaration.

methods.name: compileConstructor
methods.description: Generates the constructor method for the template class.

methods.name: compileDisplay
methods.description: Generates the doDisplay method for rendering the template.

methods.name: compileClassFooter
methods.description: Generates the closing part of the class.

methods.name: compileMacros
methods.description: Generates code for macros defined in the template.

methods.name: compileIsTraitable
methods.description: Determines if the template can be used as a trait and generates isTraitable method.

methods.name: compileLoadTemplate
methods.description: Generates code to load a template, used for traits.
